definitions.delta_f_t: If cosine_similarity(q_t, q_t-1) > tau, set delta_f_t=0. Otherwise extract facts, use the utility prompt to predict utility and filtered_facts, and compute delta_f_t from the semantically novel filtered facts in F_<=t \ F_<t divided by (|F_<=t| + epsilon).
definitions.query_similarity: Cosine similarity between dense query embeddings produced by flashrag.retriever.encoder.Encoder using text_retriever_config.
definitions.fact_similarity: Atomic facts are treated as duplicates if their normalized strings match exactly or their dense embedding cosine similarity is >= fact_similarity_threshold.
definitions.utility_filtering: The utility prompt first predicts utility_label and then filters facts based on the model's Next Reasoning Text. If utility_label is no_contribution, filtered_facts is empty and u_t=0.
definitions.trajectory_quality_score: TQS = average_t S_t within each trajectory
